title: SolarPunk Currency Framework Readiness
design_thesis: Treat SPK as an energy-denominated cryptocurrency: surplus attestations create supply, invoice settlement creates circulation, redemption burns supply into owed-kWh claims, and delivery resolution measures whether the system clears real obligations.

checks.name: Surplus issuance proof
checks.interpretation: SPK is not a naked token in the lab; it starts from an accepted surplus-energy attestation.

checks.name: Ledger conservation
checks.interpretation: The lab ledger preserves minted supply across active balances and redemption burn.

checks.name: Invoice settlement contract
checks.interpretation: SPK can now be routed as payment against hashed invoices with replay protection.

checks.name: Energy claim contract
checks.interpretation: SPK can be transferred into a registry, burned through redeemForEnergy, and converted into an owed-kWh claim.

checks.name: Delivery resolution and dispute state
checks.interpretation: The framework can track pending, fulfilled, shortfall, and disputed redemption states.

checks.name: Contract regression tests
checks.interpretation: The new currency mechanics are covered by settlement, burn/redemption, replay, slippage, fulfillment, shortfall, dispute, and re-resolution accounting tests.

checks.name: Local SPK loop
checks.interpretation: The repo can run the whole internal currency path with no external dependency: signed meter surplus, SPK mint, invoice settlement, redemption burn, owed-kWh claim, and delivery resolution.

checks.name: Empirical feed continuity
checks.interpretation: The daily data loop is long enough to support continuing empirical claims instead of a one-off demo.

internal_boundary: This is an internal engineering-readiness artifact. It measures whether the currency mechanism is coherent, testable, and empirically instrumented; it does not assert legal, audit, market, or mainnet readiness.

next_build_targets.name: Currency stress harness
next_build_targets.description: Simulate multi-actor payment velocity, redemption load, reserve ratio, and delivery shortfalls under daily energy-price scenarios.

next_build_targets.name: Deployable currency stack
next_build_targets.description: Add a deployment script and public readback for SolarPunkCurrencySystem beside the attestation-enabled SPK proof stack.

next_build_targets.name: Real meter export loop
next_build_targets.description: Replace the fixture meter bundle with a real inverter or utility export while keeping the same local SPK script and accounting checks.

references.name: BIS unified ledger/tokenisation framing
references.relevance: Separates asset records, money/settlement instruments, and programmable rules.

references.name: NIST Smart Grid program
references.relevance: Anchors the need for interoperable, measurement-based energy data.

references.name: Chainlink Proof of Reserve
references.relevance: Design pattern for reserve-backed mint controls and transparent backing feeds.

references.name: OpenZeppelin ERC20
references.relevance: Base token standard and burnable token extension used by SPK.
